profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
👋 Hi, I’m César Martinez

👀 I’m interested in building software solutions for problems in areas such as banking, finance and marketing. Currently I'm working at an IT consulting firm using python to develop APIs interfacing with machine learning cloud services.

🌱 I’m currently studying design and architecture patterns, TDD, DDD, algorithms and data structures (among other things). I generally try to stay updated on the latest technologies, but I dedicate most of my time on studying the fundamentals to develop high quality software.

💞️ I’m currently quite booked on professional projects but if you need mentorship for making a career switch into IT/Data Science, feel free to reach out.

📫 You can follow me on twitter as @cemar_ortiz and you can send me an email at cemar.ortiz@gmail.com

You can check out my projects portfolio at: https://github.com/cemar-ortiz/showroom . It is a bit outdated, since I've started my current job I haven't worked on my personal projects, but I'll be working on some new projects soon to practice new skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Big data pipelines, data reporting and visualization products using a combination of Python, Spark, ReactJS and Streamlit for a client in the real estate business
- Agentic/MCP integrations in Databricks/Snowflake
positions.insights: Python, Optimización de Flujos de Procesamiento de Big Data and +3 skills

positions.title: NGS Data Scientist
positions.description: Standarization of RiboSeq technique for NGS Data Analysis. Bioinformatic Analysis using R and report generation pipelines with Python (Cleaning, Transformation, Analysis and Visualization).

positions.title: Master in Science, Research Student
positions.description: Synthetic Biology and Systems Biology Lab. Research project using molecular biology techniques and data analysis for action definition to improve bacterial factories.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Procesamiento de datos y tecnología de procesamiento de datos
